text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Today is the anniversary of the Arab Cooperation Council which was set up by Iraq, Jordan, Yemen and Egypt.
- Uday Saddam Hussein receives ministers and senior officials who greet him on the Moslem feast of Eid al-Fitr.
- Iraqi Red Crescent Society distributes foodstuffs among children with malnutrition.
(The above stories were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA)
- Oil ministry undersecretary says Iraq plans to increase its oil reserve.
